fixture_kind: synthetic CPU reference inputs; not recorded model responses
purpose: Learn digit similarity through paired examples and contrastive loss.
mechanism: Twin branches share an encoder; ContrastiveLoss moves matching pairs closer and nonmatching pairs beyond a margin.
experiment: Use a fixed pair split and sweep distance thresholds; report ROC/PR behavior instead of a single accuracy value.
production: Export the shared encoder and version the decision threshold with preprocessing; prevent train/test image leakage through pair construction.
